questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.correct_answer: Left: x⁴ + 2x²y² + y⁴. Right: x⁴ - 2x²y² + y⁴ + 4x²y² = x⁴ + 2x²y² + y⁴. The two sides are equal.
questions.required_method: Expand both sides (or one side) and show they are equal.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof or derivation. Essential: correct expansion of both squares and the combination -2x²y² + 4x²y² = 2x²y².

questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Prove the identity a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²).
questions.prompt_markup: Prove the identity a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²).
questions.correct_answer: (a + b)(a² - ab + b²) = a³ - a²b + ab² + a²b - ab² + b³ = a³ + b³.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof or derivation. Essential: all six products and the cancellation of -a²b + a²b and ab² - ab².
